start.speaker: Corrin
start.text: It went out and you went out with it. Both can be relit. Only one of you is asking to be.

r2.speaker: Corrin
r2.text: Four floors on one wick. Whatever you were burning, it was not oil.

r3.speaker: Corrin
r3.text: You came back up with the light still on you. I can see it. It is not a figure of speech in this building.

r4.speaker: Corrin
r4.text: The Depths. That is where the store was, and where the store was not. I have carried lanterns down there that came back heavier and I have never once opened one.

r5.speaker: Corrin
r5.text: Ten. Every one of them relit. Somebody is paying for that and it is not you and it is not me.

quiet.speaker: Corrin
quiet.text: Brackets are up. Wicks are trimmed. There is no oil, but the brackets are up.
